pr_title: Update TensorPrimitives to vectorize for size(T) is 1 or 2

issue_context.title: Vectorize TensorPrimitive generic operations for sizeof(T) < 4
issue_context.body:
https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/96451 added generic versions of the existing float-based operations, complete with vectorization. However, that vectorization is currently skipped if sizeof(T) < 4, which means it doesn't kick in for byte, sbyte, ushort, short, or char. That should be implemented (or we should explicitly decide we don't need to).

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/7e51126799d19552cbf5ee52687d31f11438dda2/src/libraries/System.Numerics.Tensors/src/System/Numerics/Tensors/netcore/TensorPrimitives.netcore.cs#L15
